issue.title: taskLinks keystroke p95 budget flakes in full npm test

task_type_fields.evidence: Observed 1/1 full npm test failures: the keystroke p95 measured 14.1 ms against a 12 ms budget. Reran the unchanged test serially with node --test --test-concurrency=1 scripts/test-block-id-prompt-task-links-api-performance.cjs: 4/4 passed, and the failed case measured 6.44 ms. Observed failure rate is 1/2 runs; it has failed in the full-suite run and passed in the focused serial rerun. Neither the taskLinks source nor this performance test changed in the merge.
task_type_fields.node_id: scripts/test-block-id-prompt-task-links-api-performance.cjs::api.taskLinks keystroke-to-rows p95 takes at most 12 ms over 5,000 tasks

issue.creation_reason: The full bob-plugins gate missed this unchanged p95 assertion once, but the same test passed in an isolated serial rerun. The bounded test node needs a focused timing fix so suite noise does not obscure real regressions.
